notes:
The render budget is no longer spent on a cart page.

Docket renders a small sample of pages to find out whether a site's content is
built by JavaScript and whether its analytics actually fire. It picked the
shallowest URLs, which on a shop means the basket — three words of text, and a
third of the sample gone.

It now prefers real content pages, and leaves carts, checkouts, logins and
search results alone unless there is nothing else to render. Beyond the waste,
rendering a cart runs that page's own JavaScript, which is not something an
audit should be doing for no benefit.
